title: Approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 47702 with Barren Ridge
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Strategy and Sustainability Officer
  Approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 47702 with Barren Ridge
  Renewable Transmission Project Habitat Restoration and Revegetation Plan
  with Chambers Group, Inc. The proposed Amendment will increase the
  contract amount by $5,000,000 from $15,550,000 to a new not to exceed
  amount of $20,550,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Increase contract amount for Barren Ridge Renewable Transmission Project habitat restoration and revegetation services from $15,550,000 to $20,550,000.
